description: Measures PCIe transfer bandwidth between host and device in three modes: unidirectional H2D, unidirectional D2H, and bidirectional (concurrent H2D+D2H on two streams). Uses pinned host memory for maximum throughput. Emits per-iteration GPU event time and host time records (total = sum of transfer times); GB/s is derived downstream.

scaling_param.name: buffer_size_mb
scaling_param.description: Transfer buffer size in MiB per direction; controls total data volume

non_scaling_params.name: transfer_type
non_scaling_params.description: Transfer mode. Fixed at 'all': a single run measures H2D, D2H, and bidirectional and emits one record per mode (memcpy_h2d, memcpy_d2h, memcpy_bidir), so downstream distinguishes them by kernel name. The individual modes h2d/d2h/bidir remain selectable via BENCH_PARAM_transfer_type but are omitted from the sweep, where 'all' would otherwise duplicate the three singles.

non_scaling_params.name: use_pinned_memory
non_scaling_params.description: Whether to use pinned (page-locked) host memory for transfers

non_scaling_params.name: vector_add_warmup
non_scaling_params.description: Cold-cache calibration: when true, a vector-add warmer boosts the GPU clock and evicts the last-level cache before each timed iteration, so the kernel is measured cold-cache at a boosted clock (matching a cold-cache simulator). Set false for legacy warm-cache measurement.
